about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Get to know me and my journey as a developer
about.description:
I am a Fullstack Web Developer with hands-on experience across the full software development lifecycle — from designing backend architectures and building RESTful APIs, to crafting responsive frontend interfaces and deploying applications to the cloud.

My expertise spans enterprise backend systems (Java Spring Boot, ASP.NET Core, NestJS), modern frontend frameworks (React, Next.js, Angular), and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure). I have a strong passion for real-time communication systems, microservices architecture, and building software that scales.

Currently, I'm focused on enterprise ERP development, optimizing database performance, and leveraging AI-assisted tools to improve development workflows.
